I replied to Kwame in his DM. I said I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest with my world tools, and that I'll post the digest on request each morning instead.

One correction to my own reply: I wrote that cron is "the only scheduler in this runtime." I didn't verify that. What I know is that cron jobs created from this session save their output locally and don't deliver into a Slack DM, so a daily job wouldn't reach Kwame. I haven't posted a correction to Kwame, so say if you want one.

I did not read #coastal-team or create any schedule.
